reports.name: AAFC Outlook for Principal Field Crops (Canada)

outlook: Grains are lower again Monday morning, extending last week's harvest-driven slide with favorable harvest weather in the forecast. December corn is down about 6 cents near $4.68 after Friday's fourth straight loss left it below its 200-day average, and November soybeans are down about 7 cents near $12.54 as last week's roughly 1.9 million tonnes of flash sales, including 558,000 tonnes to China, have done little to offset harvest pressure. Minneapolis December spring wheat is down about 5 cents near $6.71 and Chicago December wheat is down about 4 cents near $6.56, after all three U.S. wheat classes fell 9 to 9.5 cents Friday on a firmer dollar and weaker-than-expected export sales. ICE November canola is down about C$9.70 near C$789 per tonne, deeper below C$800 as Prairie farmers finish harvest and keep selling.
